descAttendance: Record member attendance for the general meeting and mark each member as present or absent.
descAttendanceReport: Summary of member attendance for the general meeting, with present/absent counts and quorum status.
descElection: Cast ballots for present members — each ballot selects up to 7 of the 15 candidates for the board.
descElectionReport: Final tally of the board election — the top 7 candidates are Elected, ranks 8-9 are Alternate, the rest are Not Elected, and tied candidates share the same rank.
descHiddenElection: Tally secret paper ballots — tap +1 for each candidate as ballots are read out. Votes are anonymous and feed the same election result.
hiddenNoPermission: You do not have permission to run the secret ballot count.
descMeetings: Create, edit and delete general meetings, choose the active meeting, and close a meeting.
descCandidates: Register the board-election candidates for the current meeting.
startNewHint: Starting a new meeting makes it the current one and closes the previously current meeting.
noMeetings: No meetings yet. Start a new meeting to begin.
confirmDeleteMeeting: Delete this meeting and all its data?
meetingCreateInfo: After creating the meeting you will be taken to the edit page to complete its settings. The new meeting is not active until you set it as current.
noMeetingSelected: No meeting selected. Choose a meeting from the list to edit.
createCandidateDescription: Register a board-election candidate for the current meeting
noCurrentMeetingHint: Start a new meeting to begin recording attendance.
attendanceLocked: Attendance can only be edited while the meeting is in Draft or Attendance-Open status.
reportNoMeeting: No meeting to report on yet.

candidateAlready: That person is already a candidate.
